data.define: Used for things with a beautiful, matching look.

misuse.text: Don't call your messy room 'aesthetic' to Mom.
misuse.why: It only fits stylish, pretty things.

data.l1_ex: 君のデスクはとても「aesthetic」だね。

native.tip: “aesthetic” = 美的な. 例文: “Your desk looks so aesthetic.”
